explanation: Stapler, Paperclip, Folder, and Post-it Note are all tangible items found on a traditional office desk. Email, however, is a digital communication method and not a physical object.

Hades (Greek), Osiris (Egyptian), Hel (Norse), and Yama (Hindu/Buddhist) are all prominent deities associated with the underworld or the realm of the dead in their respective mythologies. Zeus, however, is the supreme ruler of the Olympian gods and god of the sky and thunder in Greek mythology, not the underworld.

category: Verbs Forming Phrasal Verbs of Discovery or Resolution
explanation: The words 'Figure,' 'Point,' 'Work,' and 'Find' all form phrasal verbs with 'out' ('figure out,' 'point out,' 'work out,' 'find out') that commonly mean to discover, solve, identify, or comprehend something. 'Go out' means to leave or to cease burning/functioning, which is unrelated to discovery or resolution.
